setting: Arania (v49, with v50 magic systems from the repo Specification)

domains.name: Wyra, Fae, the Law of Wyric Oaths
Teria and the Law of Reciprocity

conceits.text: The Allhigh knows itself through play, casting off Illuminative Fragments (Souls) and releasing them constantly.
The One Maxim emanates into Supreme Maxims (Gea, Samea, Nea and others), Great Maxims, Maxims and Intents; it is met only in fragments.

The Soul bifurcates: the Elevated Soul (Soul Core, Soul Ego, Third Eye and Sacral Apertures) leaves; the Residual Soul (Inner and Outer Soul, Sea of Consciousness, Solar and Root Apertures) stays as a Shade.
Soul Depth is fixed for the whole existence of a Soul by its Fragment's proximity to the Allhigh: Upper (Highborn), Lower (Lowborn), none (Unborn).
Soul Sex is biological sex, constant across incarnations; a Female Soul cannot activate a Spiritual Root.
Every Soul holds Lina and Sul; the dominant nature is its Soul Nature, and either can ensoul either sex.
A Soul reincarnates only into one ethnicity and, if Highborn, one subcaste.
Souls enter only fit fetuses, competing by Soul Depth; a fetus no Soul takes is Unborn.
conceits.norm: Fit fetuses are ensouled; deeper Souls take fitter bodies.
conceits.deviation: Soulless fetuses become Unborn, most often among Lowborn and Unborn parents.
conceits.movers: Genetic load; Soul Depth of the competing Souls.

conceits.text: The Unborn have no Soul: no Sapience, Agency or Intellect, no Prana, no Fae, no Shade.
Three Planes; only five one-way paths lead from the Middle Plane, each sorted Upper or Lower by Teric Merit or Debt; no return.
Experiences of innate value become Lychions (Pro or Anti) in the Third Eye, erode the Divine Veil and carry across lives; a Grandsoul undergoes Renascension.
Soul Phases follow typical soul-age schedules, about ten times faster for the Highborn.
conceits.norm: Highborn reach Grandsoul near 350 soul-years, Lowborn near 3,500.
conceits.deviation: Not causative: Lychion quantity and quality decide.
conceits.movers: Lychionic opportunity, Sye Force, social station.

conceits.text: Oathfulfillment and Oathbreach attract Wyra Crystallites; the Wyric Superbase sets a Fae's odds of Fortune; Wyra follows the Shade.
conceits.norm: Primefae: between 25% chance of Fortune and 25% of Misfortune.
conceits.deviation: Sizable, Great and Extreme Merit or Debt shift it by 25, 50 and 75%.

conceits.text: The Law of Wyric Oaths: cultivators swear and witness; weight from scale, cost and duration; the subject's survival binds; consequences are impartial and shared by Prana Base.
Acts attract Teric Crystallites under the Law of Reciprocity, credited also to those who influenced them in proportion to their influence.
Paragons ascend to the Upper Plane and Nadirs descend to the Lower Plane at death; Saints and Fiends go to Higher and Lower Worlds; Benefactors and Malefactors are reborn to good or ill station.
Every emotional connection makes a one-way Sye String from sender to object; brightness is intensity, solidity is the sender's Sye Control; intense experience makes Radiant Strings.
Sye Control passes through bloodlines as the parents' average.
conceits.deviation: Slight variation; concentrated bloodlines transmit more consistently.

conceits.text: A Domain whose Sye passes a threshold becomes a Real Domain; its Sye falls to its Dominators, whose power is that Sye plus their share of it.
Apparitions (Radiant Strings plus a Personal Real Domain) are indestructible while fed Sye and die only of Sye deprivation.
Every ensouled death leaves a Shade bound to tomb and Shadeshrine, fed by kin, able to possess those of lower Sye Control.
A Shade keeps the Prana Core as a Shade Core and its techniques, and can no longer cultivate (SHADES, first statement).
A Fallacious Phenomenal Domain that passes the threshold becomes real: a Paroxysm re-derives history forward and back under the Law of Phenomenal Causality, making a new Planar State.
Once formed, a Phenomenal Real Domain remains through all later Planar States; each stream holds all the previous stream's Real Domains.
Phenomenal Collapse: of two contradicting Phenomenal Real Domains, the one with more causal relations erases the other from all causality, memory and evidence.
Fate and Destiny are fixed, invariant across Planar States, avertable but unalterable.
Extraterrestrial memory, Lychions and Fate survive Collapse: erasure is an operation of Sye, and Divinity outranks Sye.
Narrative convergence: small challengers feed incumbents; Collapses grow rarer and larger; every Narrative Space ends under one Song and one apex Dominator.
conceits.norm: Long plateaus of a Great-Song oligopoly.
conceits.deviation: Great Collapses consolidate the oligopoly by one.
conceits.movers: Fame, causal density, contradiction along abutting cones.

conceits.text: Belief Follows Power: a state is a Sye catchment; arms impose Canon, Canon redirects Sye, Sye strengthens Real Domains, Real Domains yield Arcana, Arcana strengthens arms.
Conversion runs on generational time, and cultural barriers between Narrative Spaces resist it.
The Gift is inherited and infallible: it perceives Wyra, Fae, Teria, Lychionic Type and Soul Phase, never Fate, Destiny or another's Sye Force.
Highborn mediums are infertile, the Gift being incongruous with high Sye Force; the Lowborn bear the Gift without penalty.
Cultivation needs Upper Soul Depth and an active Spiritual Root; Prana Realms climb a seven-rung scale; reaching the Empyrean forces transmigration (v50).
Every seignory's enclave serves a Luminary; feudatories need the seignory priest's coronation; all clergy are celibate Highborn male cultivators.
An Emperor needs an Ascendant Prana Base, every piece of the Imperial Regalia, Verne, and coronation there by its Archbishop.
The Peerage is bound by Tenurial Oaths (vassal to overlord) and Patrimonial Oaths (juzerain to suzerain).
Relics are Material Real Domains, held by possession and Soul Imprint, destroyed only by narrative erasure.
It is impossible for women to enter the Upper or Lower Plane through Teria alone.
Base Sye Capacity is alike in everyone but the Intented; Seas of Consciousness run Mortal to Immortal.
Each star system stands on a continuum of moral authority, more Proteric or more Antiteric.
The Blue Star; the Seven Realms, one supercontinent of about 90 million km2 and 1.92 billion people; 490 states; 1712 AC.
The 42nd Epoch; the Cycle of Man, third of three Cycles; the Modern Age, Sixth Era.
History, draft A: the Deluge left only the Seven Realms standing; the First Era lay wholly in Eastern Arania; Arians formed from Almans, Tharions and Aldeans.
History, draft B: the Deluge left only Asteria and Sylycia standing; the First Era lay wholly in Asteria; Arians formed from Almans and Aldeans.
Highborn often give birth to Lowborn.
The Unborn are property: the produce of their parents, bought and sold, without legal protection.
Highborn Teria swings widely; Highborn reincarnate about a dozen times before ascending or descending.
Highborn reach Grandsoul, and so Renascension, near 350 soul-years.
Most Extraterrestrials are Highborn men.
The enclave network: sanctuaries, temples, havens and shrines, one patron Luminary per seignory.
Templars subjugate Devourers and re-sing their Real Domains to their patron Luminary.
Great Clans feed their Guardians on the high Sye Control of Highborn clansmen.
The Magnificent Charter (1366 AC), a Level V Sacred Oath, binds all present title holders; no sovereign dares go against it.
The Arian Narrative Space: one civilizational Canon, a collection of Great Songs, very hard to dismantle.
Sung land is hard and unsung land soft; the westward advance of civilization has hardened the world.
The Eras alternate between warring states and empire.
Ages end in civilizational collapse, dealt by invading barbarians.
Mediums form an endogamous Lowborn caste under cultivator patrons who swear for their testimony.
Nearly every Arian home keeps a Shadeshrine; the Festival of the Dead sits outside the One Faith.
The Residual Soul is merely an earthly mirage; the Elevated Soul is the true seat of the being.
The One Faith zealously holds the Doctrine of the Supremacy of the Elevated Soul; holyknights hold it, darknights do not.
The Allhigh is an evil entity trapping souls in an evil reality.
The Eastern Heresy took hold in Asteria under Markule and was put down by Holy War.
Arcane power brought down the Aldean Empire.
It is believed, without evidence, that Arcane power caused the Aldean fall.
Subrace Narrative Spaces, each with its own Canon of songs.
Imperial conquest across the Realms (Valyrean, Kalean).
States as Sye catchments: borders drift toward the divides of Sye drainage.
Witness: a Lowborn-souled child of Highborn parents inherits high Sye Control.
Witness: no non-cultivator ever holds Wyra; every Lowborn's and every woman's Fae is Primefae.
Three castes: Peers (Highborn), Commoners (Lowborn), Lessers (Unborn).
Apotheists are typically Highborn; a Lowborn reaches Apotheosis only through fame beyond the Honor Group.
Extraterrestrials of different departures remember mutually inconsistent histories: the Upper and Lower Planes archive superseded Planar States.
Ten classes of Extraterrestrial: Celestial and Sidereal Caeliors, Halcyrs, Aurions, Beatrions and Veridals.
Streams lengthen, and each Planar State holds more Phenomenal Real Domains than the last.
The Primordial Jeten knows every Destiny and the whole of Fate.
Seven sets of Real Armaments, the Imperial Regalia among them.

relations.justification: Great Clans and Templar Orders contest which class of the dead harvests the living; the contest's product is the Sye drainage map recorded at G2.
Mediums serve oath adjudication; the relation regulates testimony and mints nothing.
Household and clan feeding of Shades share one Sye pool; regulation only.
Teric swing and exit share the same souls; the exit is a fate, not a new unit.
Templars re-sing Devourers' Real Domains to the Luminaries the enclaves house; regulation of Sye shares.
The Charter settled a revolt against the Kalean Empire; recorded as the Election L09.
Births sort into castes and the Unborn; the sorting is the whole relation.

loops.text: Belief Follows Power: arms impose Canon; Canon redirects Sye; Sye yields Arcana; Arcana strengthens arms.
Dominators gather Sye through songs; Sye strengthens Dominators, who sponsor more songs.
Fame attracts contradiction; annexation raises causal density; density raises fame.
Challengers to an incumbent Song cross the threshold and lose, feeding it: perturbations return opposed.
Luminaries' Real Domains fund the Faith; the Faith's templars re-sing Devourers' Domains to Luminaries.

questions.text: When an ethnicity merges into another or ends, where can its Souls reincarnate?
Can a Fallacious Phenomenal Real Domain contradict a Soul's Fate, and which yields?
Do Teric and Wyric balances, Shade memories and Honor survive when the Acts behind them are re-derived away by a Paroxysm?
Is Teria attributed to an influencer conserved (split with the actor) or multiplied (both credited in full)?
Can Extraterrestrials or Primordials act on, or communicate with, the Middle Plane after its creation?
By what test is the Soul Depth, and so the caste, of a woman or a non-cultivating man established?
Can a Lowborn-souled child of a Peer inherit a title?
From what baseline do the Fae's 25, 50 and 75% shifts of Fortune run?
Is the content of a widely witnessed Descriptive Wyric Oath a Phenomenal Domain for Realization?
What can an Unborn body do (labor, training, response to command)?
How is a Hybrid formed, and can the human refuse it?
Is 'combined Prana Base' for witness thresholds summed in Prana or read by rank?
Who represents civilization, and so can trigger the Charter's Wyra, when there is no Emperor?
Can a non-cultivator acquire Wyra?
Can a being of the Upper or Lower Plane enter the Middle Plane?
Can a Residual Soul leave the Middle Plane?
Can an Apparition be destroyed by force?
Can a Lowborn Soul become Highborn?
Can a coerced Wyric Oath bind?
Can a Narrative Space hold an oligopoly of Great Songs?
Can star systems differ in moral authority?
Can a Lowborn become an Apotheist?
Which Great Songs make up the Arian oligopoly today?
Which star systems are the most Proteric?
Which Lowborn Apotheists exist in 1712 AC?

witnesses.note: A lord forces a rival to swear a ruinous oath: it binds (1.4), but the coercion is an Antiact; Teria prices Wyra abuse.
A present lord breaches the Charter: he is neither its oathswearer nor its witness, so no Wyra falls on him.
A Lowborn-souled child of Peers bears the Gift and the bloodline's high Sye Force.
A dozen Highborn lives against Grandsoul at about 350 soul-years.
1.92 billion over about 90 million km2 is about 21 per km2: between medieval Europe overall (under 10) and its densest kingdoms (30 to 40).
Run F1 forward: conquest without conversion loses; only imperial duration converts. Coherent, but nothing records why most polities die young.
A previous stream's Real Domain loses a Collapse.
A cultivator dies with no Radiant String: Shade Core or not?
An Apotheist Paragon dies: Caelior or Beatrion?
A Saint dies into a Higher World outside its ethnicity.
A Lady who persuades her lord to war is credited Teria by influence.
Phantoms self-sustain on a Personal Real Domain; Apparitions with one must hunt Sye.
Nobody perceives Soul Depth: not mediums, not the self. Closure question Q06, not a conflict.
A Luminary-serving Faith teaches that the Residual Soul, the Luminaries' own kind, is a mirage.
Derived: every non-cultivator's Fae is Primefae for life (L26).
The Unborn have no Demonstrated Interests, so harm to one is Irreciprocity only against its owner: Teria and the property rule cohere.
Jeten's foreknowledge of the whole Palimpsest needs Fate's invariance (S26); stated stochastic Realization is epistemic for in-world agents.
Imperial consolidation of subrace Canons into one Canon, and borders following Sye drainage, both follow from S29 over S28 and S30.
'Base Sye Capacity is alike' against seven Seas: reconciled if the Seas grade only the Intented (v50).

ledger.text: S24 (Real Domains persist through all later Planar States) against S25 (Collapse erases the loser). Both Strict. Reclassifies to S under the scope patch: permanence holds against re-derivation, not against contradiction.
SHADES: every Shade carries the Prana Core (first statement) against only cultivators with Radiant Strings keep it (later statement).
Medium infertility keyed on caste (Highborn) against its stated mechanism keyed on Sye Force, which follows bloodline; the two part where Highborn bear Lowborn.
Saints and Fiends go to Higher and Lower Worlds at death, against the ethnicity lock and the closure of the five paths; 'Higher Worlds' undefined.
Exit priority undecided where triggers coincide: an Apotheist who is also a Paragon, Saint, Fiend or Nadir; an Empyrean breakthrough and a Great Maxim at once.
'Impossible for women ... through Teria alone' is Strict, but rests on a Tendency ('approaching zero'); persuasion credits Teria to influential women.
The Charter binds present title holders and no sovereign dares breach it, but the Law binds only consenting witnesses and the oathswearer, both of 1366.
Revenant = postmortem Apotheosis with Sye Deviation, against 'all Revenants originate as Spirits': the postmortem/postmortem cell is undecided.
Phantoms self-sustain, Apparitions must secure Sye: Radiant Strings are outflow (Strings are one-way from sender).
History drafts A and B (B03, B04): what the Deluge spared, where the First Era lay, who formed the Arians, how long Eras run.
Alike base Sye Capacity against seven Seas of Consciousness.
'Honor' names both Sye in the Personal Domain (metaphysics) and membership of the Honor Group (institution); 'Highborn men' against 'the Highborn'.
Highborn reincarnate about a dozen times before exit, yet reach Grandsoul (immediate Renascension) near 350 soul-years: consistent only if a Highborn life averages about 30 years.
Dominators named as Ancestors, Revenants and Relics; the mechanism (a Personal or Material Real Domain) also admits Guardians, Phantoms and living Apotheists; 'Ancestor' undefined.
The Faith serves Luminaries (Residual Souls) while teaching the Residual Soul is a mirage.
ledger.rationale: Resolved by the setting's own Sye economy: the Doctrine devalues household and clan Shades, drawing Sye from Shadeshrines and Guardians toward Luminaries (S29). Accepted pending the author's word.
